device: Apple Silicon Mac, Chrome (new guest profile), and iPhone 15, Home Screen app with the Mac's Web Inspector; the staging Worker serving the real sf world

steps.instruction: Confirm that docs/bake-runs/M02c2/staging.json exists and that config/world/release.json names staging: "sf" (the M02c2 AC-14 release). If either is missing, stop: this checklist waits for that release and nothing here is recorded before it.

Desktop Chrome on an Apple Silicon Mac, in a new guest profile (an empty pack store), open the staging URL and start free roam. After the world is revealed, run JSON.parse(document.documentElement.dataset.dvBoot) in the console and record the result in notes.json as desktop.cold (tier, requests, bytes, revealMs, waves, inflightPeak).

In the DevTools console context named asset.worker (the context selector above the console), run: const e = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((r) => r.name.includes('/media/')); const t = e.map((r) => r.responseStart - r.requestStart).sort((a, b) => a - b); ({ count: e.length, p50: t[Math.floor(t.length * 0.5)], p95: t[Math.floor(t.length * 0.95)], protocols: [...new Set(e.map((r) => r.nextHopProtocol))] }). Record the object as desktop.media. Informational only: if Resource Timing is not offered in that context, write "unavailable" and carry on.
Reload the page (the pack store now holds the boot set), start free roam again and record JSON.parse(document.documentElement.dataset.dvBoot) as desktop.warm.

On the iPhone 15, open the staging URL from the Home Screen app (Add to Home Screen first, then launch it with an empty pack store: remove the app and Website Data if it ran before) and connect the Mac's Safari Web Inspector. Start free roam. After the reveal run JSON.parse(document.documentElement.dataset.dvBoot) in the Inspector console and record it as iphone.cold. If the Inspector offers the asset.worker context, run the step 3 snippet there and record the object as iphone.media (informational). Note the network type (Wi-Fi or cellular) as iphone.network.

Write uw8: { desktop, iphone } in notes.json. Each value is "pass" when its cold revealMs is at most 1000 times warmBootToPlayableS of the tier that device reported in dataset.dvBoot.tier (tiers.<tier>.boot.warmBootToPlayableS in config/tier-budgets.json), otherwise "fail". Save notes.json to docs/device-runs/M02f1/staging/notes.json and commit it. A fail is a finding for the Architect (the lever order of DL-722), not a reason to change this milestone.
